# Expressive Voice 2.6

Installs as an update over 2.5 and the betas (same package name and signing key).

## New
- **Long-press shortcut** — long-press the app icon and tap **Record** to start recording right away and land on the live recording screen.
- **Works with Shortcut Maker, KWGT and Tasker** — a "Start recording" entry is available in their shortcut and activity pickers (action `com.captechomar.recorder.action.QUICK_RECORD`).

## Changed
- Tapping the recording notification now opens the recording screen.
